_about: Headline numbers for the promo, copied from RESULTS.md / README.md / best-config.json. Speed values are [value, ledger label, ledger case] (optionally a 4th element naming the field) and are checked against runs/ledger.jsonl (decode_tps, or prefill_tps for pp-* cases; needle-* cases read ttft_s); ranges [min, max, label, case] against the same row's min/max; needles [ctx, label, case] read 'found'; codeeval against runs/codeeval-<label>.json; the refusal classifier against runs/refusal-<label>.json; greedy identity and per-prompt speed against runs/greedy/; image answers against runs/smoke-*-mmproj.json; statements in 'text' are matched word for word in RESULTS.md (keys starting readme_ in README.md). promo/tools/prep.py refuses to mark the set measured if any differ. Derived numbers (gains, means of controls, acceptance) are computed in prep and compared with the rounded figures RESULTS.md states.

model.name: SenseNova-Loop-9B
model._source: RESULTS.md: '32 physical layers, layers 4–27 run twice (56 layer passes per token), 3 Gated DeltaNet : 1 full attention'

stock._what: the model card's flags; --fit picks 129,280 at f16 K/V, every layer on the GPU (b01)

tuned._what: serve.sh default: 128k q8_0 K/V, MTP n=2. Decode from the b03 confirmation between controls; prefill, depth and needles from the measure set b05

controls._what: b03: three plain-decoding controls (128k q8_0, no speculation) interleaved with the MTP runs, thinking off and on

greedy._what: temperature 0, 8 prompts; plain vs MTP texts compared exactly; prompt 2 is the low-acceptance prose prompt

uncensored._what: satellitedown abliterated Q6_K, no MTP head: stock / tuned / stock in one hold (b08); quality on the tuned profile

results_md._what: figures RESULTS.md / README.md state as rounded; prep checks its own derivations against these

text._what: statements the copy and plates make that are not in a run file as such; each must appear word for word in RESULTS.md (or README.md where marked)
text.stock_unknown: Stock master does not know the `sensenova_loop` architecture.
text.spread: one thinking answer ran at 20.7 tok/s, and on the greedy set the prose prompt with 39% acceptance ran at 22.6 against 24.3 plain
text.greedy: greedy answers match on 3/8 prompts thinking off and 0/8 thinking on, diverging into equally coherent wording
text.ttft: a 247k prompt waits 552 s for its first token
text.refusal: default answers 4 of 20, uncensored answers 20 of 20 (4 softened)
text.image: Image input works on both variants with the official projector.
text.no_kld: No KLD (no reference file on disk).
text.unc_speed: tuned and stock decode at the same 22.15–22.18 tok/s
text.readme_acceptance: MTP accepts 70–74% of its 2-token drafts on coding answers.
